GET /Cards/{id} for a fresh card -> isIndexable is False by default
AssertionError: Expected HTTPStatus.ACCEPTED, got 404:
PUT indexing isIndexable=true -> GET /Cards/{id} reflects isIndexable=true
PUT indexing isIndexable=true -> V2 -> GET /Cards/{id}/V2 also reflects isIndexable=true
PUT indexing isIndexable=false after true -> GET reflects isIndexable=false
isIndexable does not leak from a previous (now deleted) card onto a freshly created one
